{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the presence of the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print('Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):', len(qa_orders))

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']
print('Number of refunded orders:', len(refunded_orders))

# Show the actual channels present
print('\nChannels present:', sales['channel'].unique())

# Check if revenue column contains commas
print('\nSample revenue values with commas:', sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).sum())"}
